programs.desc: Host and comedian Byron Allen invites four A-List comedians to this round-table comedy talk show. programs.title: Funny You Should Ask
programs.desc: Former "Extra" correspondent Jon Kelley hosts this comedy game show that features a panel of comedians interacting with two contestants, who have a chance to win cash if they can read between the lines of the comics' jokes. The contestants ask the comedians questions, to which the jokemakers give humorous answers. The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash.
